prompts.name: atlas-bootstrap
prompts.description: Refresh the agent's understanding of the TestAtlas constitution and reaffirm the rules in effect for this session per PRD §12.2.

prompts.name: atlas-cleanup
prompts.description: Workspace housekeeping confined to _testatlas/ — orphan removal, broken-link triage, stale-marker resolution, index re-derivation. Never deletes user content.

prompts.name: atlas-consolidate
prompts.description: Squash issue duplicates per triage groupings; inherit highest severity + lowest-bound confidence; refresh _testatlas/13_quality_scorecard.md longitudinal series.

prompts.name: atlas-core-bootstrap-refresh
prompts.description: Re-read the constitution, validate token budget, and refresh bootstrap shards so a long-running agent doesn't drift from the rules.

prompts.name: atlas-core-brain-compact
prompts.description: Summarize long transcripts and run logs into durable summaries; keeps the brain compact without losing decisions or evidence.

prompts.name: atlas-core-brain-export
prompts.description: Export the V2 brain as a JSON dump, a graph snapshot, or a full archive — for handoff, dashboards, or backup.

prompts.name: atlas-core-brain-query
prompts.description: Answer a question about the workspace by reading brain JSON; cite file paths for every claim.

prompts.name: atlas-core-brain-sync
prompts.description: Detect and reconcile drift between markdown artifacts and brain JSON indexes; orchestrates sync-markdown-json + validate-brain.

prompts.name: atlas-core-brain-validate
prompts.description: Run AJV validation across the entire `_testatlas/brain/` tree (22 files) and report any findings.

prompts.name: atlas-core-init
prompts.description: Bootstrap or upgrade a TestAtlas V2 workspace — creates `_testatlas/brain/` skeleton, registers adapters, and writes a v2 manifest.

prompts.name: atlas-core-status
prompts.description: Summarize the current TestAtlas workspace — phase, counts, blockers, stale areas — by reading the V2 brain state.

prompts.name: atlas-council-brain-audit
prompts.description: Brain Audit Council — personas inspect the _testatlas workspace for staleness, contradictions, missing updates, and bad structure through the 9-round protocol.

prompts.name: atlas-council-bug-triage
prompts.description: Bug triage council — multiple personas classify and prioritize open issues by severity, priority, and remediation sequencing through the 9-round protocol.

prompts.name: atlas-council-design-critique
prompts.description: Design Critique — Product Strategist, User Advocate, and Accessibility Reviewer critique a UI flow's user experience, copy, navigation, and a11y through the 9-round protocol.

prompts.name: atlas-council-domain-review
prompts.description: Roundtable review of a domain — every persona reads the domain's docs, evidence, and brain slice and contributes findings, claims, and disagreements through the 9-round protocol.

prompts.name: atlas-council-flow-review
prompts.description: Roundtable review of a single user flow — personas read the flow doc, route map, evidence, and run logs and contribute findings, claims, and disagreements through the 9-round protocol.

prompts.name: atlas-council-product-review
prompts.description: Debate-mode council on product priority, feature coherence, and tradeoffs — personas argue for/against a conclusion through the 9-round protocol.

prompts.name: atlas-council-red-team
prompts.description: Red Team Challenge — adversarial personas attempt to find hidden risks and invalidate confident claims through the 9-round protocol.

prompts.name: atlas-council-release-readiness
prompts.description: Release readiness council — personas weigh blockers, coverage, drift, and council consensus into a documented go / conditional / no-go decision through the 9-round protocol.

prompts.name: atlas-council-retest
prompts.description: Retest council — personas evaluate whether a claimed fix satisfies the issue's acceptance criteria through the 9-round protocol.

prompts.name: atlas-council-test-plan
prompts.description: Test Plan Council — QA, automation, codebase, data, and runtime personas propose a complete testing plan through the 9-round protocol.

prompts.name: atlas-council
prompts.description: Umbrella router for V2 council commands. Selects a conversation mode + topic + participants and dispatches to the matching council-* sub-command.

prompts.name: atlas-explore-accessibility
prompts.description: Evaluate keyboard nav, focus, labels, semantics, contrast, dynamic feedback per PRD §13.9 via mandatory Chrome DevTools MCP a11y walkthrough (lighthouse_audit + ARIA introspection); degrade to code-reading without MCP.

prompts.name: atlas-explore-api
prompts.description: Map REST/GraphQL/RPC/server-action/webhook/event-consumer surfaces; capture contracts, auth, errors, pagination; safely probe sandbox endpoints.

prompts.name: atlas-explore-cli
prompts.description: Map package scripts, binaries, and task runners for the target product; classify destructive vs safe commands; capture help text and exit codes for safe ones.

prompts.name: atlas-explore-codebase
prompts.description: Map the target product across languages, frameworks, monorepo layout, apps/services/workers, routes, handlers, jobs, integrations, and data flows; produce 12_app_map.json plus a domain inventory.

prompts.name: atlas-explore-data
prompts.description: Map schemas, entities, lifecycle states, seed fixtures, queues, caches, and storage objects from local schema introspection; never read or persist production rows.

prompts.name: atlas-explore-docs
prompts.description: Inventory README, PRDs, stories, ADRs, specs, and supporting docs in the target repo; normalize substantial requirements into _testatlas/stories/; flag stale or conflicting docs.

prompts.name: atlas-explore-integrations
prompts.description: Map auth, payments, email, analytics, storage, webhooks, and feature-flag integrations; distinguish sandbox/test/prod endpoints; probe sandbox only when safe.

prompts.name: atlas-explore-performance
prompts.description: Detect user-visible slowness, blocking interactions, retries, reliability per PRD §13.10 via mandatory Chrome DevTools MCP perf walkthrough (baseline + throttled traces, performance_analyze_insight); degrade to code-reading without MCP.

prompts.name: atlas-explore-runtime
prompts.description: Map how to run the target product safely — package scripts, Docker, env vars, ports, migrations, seeds, mock servers; start local services only when safe.

prompts.name: atlas-explore-security
prompts.description: Catalog auth surfaces, secrets-handling locations, and redaction risks per PRD §6.5 — read-only defensive audit; never attempts exploitation; never persists secret values.

prompts.name: atlas-explore-ui
prompts.description: Map routes, components, forms, modals, PRD §13.1 UI states (empty/loading/error/success/permission), responsive breakpoints, a11y basics via mandatory Chrome DevTools MCP walkthrough; degrade to code-reading when MCP unavailable.

prompts.name: atlas-explore
prompts.description: Umbrella explorer orchestrator — classifies sub-explorers, spawns the recommended ones in parallel via subagent-spawn, and aggregates findings into _testatlas/02_product_overview.md alongside _testatlas/explore-plan.md.

prompts.name: atlas-explore-all
prompts.description: V2 umbrella explorer that classifies and routes all 20 V1+V2 explorers, applies idempotency filtering, selects an execution mode (parallel-subagents / sequential-fallback / classify-only), and aggregates findings.

prompts.name: atlas-explore-brain
prompts.description: Audit the V2 brain workspace consistency — stale docs, invalid JSON, missing indexes, dangling cross-references, drift between markdown and JSON, orphaned evidence.

prompts.name: atlas-explore-components
prompts.description: Inventory every UI component with props, state dependencies, responsive behavior, accessibility basics, and observed routes via mandatory Chrome DevTools MCP walkthrough; degrade to code-reading when MCP unavailable.

prompts.name: atlas-explore-errors
prompts.description: Map error boundaries, fallback UI, error logging, retry patterns, and exception flows via mandatory Chrome DevTools MCP walkthrough; degrade to code-reading when MCP unavailable.

prompts.name: atlas-explore-jobs
prompts.description: Map background jobs, schedules, queues, retry policies, timeouts, and failure scenarios; observable via shell + log inspection; degrade to code-reading when shell unavailable.

prompts.name: atlas-explore-observability
prompts.description: Map logging setup, metrics, alerts, and tracing — verify log generation, metric collection, alert triggers, and distributed-trace propagation. Static audit + live probe when shell available.

prompts.name: atlas-explore-release-readiness
prompts.description: Map release artifacts, blockers, readiness state, version tags, and gates. Synthesizes signal from prior explorers into a release/no-go decision report.

prompts.name: atlas-explore-routes
prompts.description: Map every route, navigation paths, guards, redirects, deep-link behavior, history (back/forward), and per-route ownership via mandatory Chrome DevTools MCP walkthrough; degrade to code-reading when MCP unavailable.

prompts.name: atlas-explore-security-privacy
prompts.description: Map auth flows, permission boundaries, sensitive-data handling, injection risks, and privacy controls. V2 expansion of V1 explore-security with mandatory walkthrough when browser+MCP available.

prompts.name: atlas-explore-state
prompts.description: Map UI states (empty, loading, error, success, permission) plus state transitions, default/initial states, and error recovery via mandatory Chrome DevTools MCP walkthrough; degrade to code-reading when MCP unavailable.

prompts.name: atlas-explore-tests
prompts.description: Inventory existing tests, measure coverage, identify gaps, surface flaky tests. Static audit + live test-runner probe when shell available.

prompts.name: atlas-handoff
prompts.description: Write a sub-agent handoff record at _testatlas/handoffs/HANDOFF-<timestamp>.{md,json} validating against sub-agent-handoff.schema.json with explicit context boundaries.

prompts.name: atlas-init
prompts.description: Bootstrap the _testatlas/ workspace tree in a target repository — 23 subdirs, 14 canonical files, and a project manifest — idempotently.

prompts.name: atlas-log-issue
prompts.description: Capture a quality finding as an issue under to_fix/ with severity, confidence, evidence references, and back-links to flows/domains per PRD §17.

prompts.name: atlas-map-domains
prompts.description: Distill the app-map into per-domain functional models under _testatlas/domains/<slug>/, where each domain owns a coherent set of routes, APIs, components, jobs, and integrations per PRD §15.

prompts.name: atlas-plan
prompts.description: Produce a risk-based, domain-based, flow-based, state-aware test strategy and master plan covering 02_test_strategy.md, plans/PLAN-master.md, the test matrix, and exploratory charters per PRD §12.14.

prompts.name: atlas-report
prompts.description: Aggregate runs, issues, evidence, and coverage into reports/REPORT-latest.md (and a timestamped copy) with all 17 PRD §20 sections; refresh per-area views and the quality scorecard.

prompts.name: atlas-retest
prompts.description: Re-execute the original repro for issues with status=fixed_pending_retest; transition to closed (recovered) or reopened (still failing); append append-only retest history; capture new evidence.

prompts.name: atlas-test-accessibility
prompts.description: Execute accessibility-typed scenarios via mandatory Chrome DevTools MCP a11y walkthrough (lighthouse_audit + ARIA introspection); assert against PRD §13.9 thresholds; emit RUN-<timestamp>.{md,json} with per-scenario a11y findings.

prompts.name: atlas-test-all
prompts.description: Umbrella test orchestrator — runs `/atlas:test-flow --all` AND `/atlas:test-domain --all` and aggregates per-child run records into a single merged RUN-<timestamp>.{md,json}.

prompts.name: atlas-test-domain
prompts.description: Execute domain-scoped scenarios across PRD §26 modes (negative/state/integration/setup-testability); state-typed UI scenarios drive the mandatory Chrome DevTools MCP state-coverage walkthrough (5 states); scenario.type selects mode.

prompts.name: atlas-test-flow
prompts.description: Execute scenarios from tests/matrix.json against running target via mandatory Chrome DevTools MCP interactive-surface walkthrough (forms, modals, navigation, keyboard); capture per-state evidence; emit RUN-<timestamp>.{md,json} per PRD §13.

prompts.name: atlas-test-performance
prompts.description: Execute performance-typed scenarios via mandatory Chrome DevTools MCP perf walkthrough (baseline + throttled traces, performance_analyze_insight, emulate); assert PRD §13.10 thresholds; emit RUN-<timestamp>.{md,json} with perf findings.

prompts.name: atlas-test-regression
prompts.description: Re-run previously-failed scenarios from prior RUN-<timestamp>.json files; diff against the prior failed run; report regressed / recovered / unchanged / unverified per scenario.

prompts.name: atlas-triage
prompts.description: Deduplicate, normalize, group, and flag-as-blocker the issues under _testatlas/to_fix/; identify missing evidence; emit triage-report-<timestamp>.md.

prompts.name: atlas-uninstall
prompts.description: Remove the TestAtlas suite tree (`.testatlas/`) per the install manifest; with `--purge`, also remove the `_testatlas/` workspace. Operator-confirmed; never runs without explicit invocation.

prompts.name: atlas-update
prompts.description: Invoke the suite self-update flow — checks GitHub Releases per UPDATE-01, delegates to Phase 7 update.js for atomic apply with backup, never auto-applies without operator confirmation.

prompts.name: atlas-validate-workspace
prompts.description: Schema-validate the _testatlas/ workspace; surface drift, broken links, orphaned evidence, and other PRD §33 violations as findings.
